verdict.rationale: SendGrid's Inbound Parse webhook parses incoming email and its attachments, then POSTs that data to a URL you choose. That covers only the POST-to-endpoint part of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows rule-based routing on recipient or pattern, multiple endpoints per rule, or built-in forward or store actions. Missing for 10: recipient/pattern matching rules, per-rule routing to different endpoints, forward and store actions, in-depth docs and hands-on corroboration of routing behavior.
